desc: Please find enclosed herewith Annual Report pursuant to Regulation 34(1) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

Please find enclosed herewith Intimation for 33rd Annual General Meeting of Ashika Global Securities Limited (formerly, Ashika Credit Capital Limited) scheduled to be held on Saturday, 19.09.2026 at 11:30 a.m. onwards through VC/OAVM.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that in compliance with Regulation 36(1)(b) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Company has completed dispatch of letter to those shareholders whose email addresses are not registered with Company/ Depositories, providing weblink of Company''s website where Annual Report for FY 2025-26 and Notice convening 33rd AGM can be accessed from.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith copies of newspaper advertisement published today, i.e. Wednesday, 26.08.2026 in Financial Express- English- All India Edition and Arthik Lipi- Bengali- West Bengal Edition.
